Gesture Command Reference

Standard spatial heuristics recognized by the machine vision model.

Index Point Move cursor anywhere on screen with smooth Kalman stabilization.
Pinch (Index+Thumb) Left click on any interactive target or trigger on-screen items.
Pinch & Hold Grab and drag windows, scrollbars, or draw continuous lines on canvas.
Two Fingers Up Vertical page navigation and smooth scrolling up and down.
⋮⋮
4 Fingers Up Fast scrolling through long documents, logs, and web pages.
Thumb Up Right click context menu trigger at the active cursor position.
Open Palm Pause / standby mode. Releases mouse focus and resets tracking.
Closed Fist Full idle mode. Suppresses unintended clicks and motions.
